title: Author Layer 1 Director Invocation Tests
instructions: Create the file: this chunk owns the module docstring, imports and constants. Write physical pytest cases (real subprocess, real SQLite WAL, psutil; no mock objects): test_f04_fable_invocation_constructs_valid_cli_arguments for SRS-412-03-FR-001 (Layer 1 CLI-level internal swarms shall execute through a single `claude.exe` process hosting Claude Fable 5.1 Director.); test_f04_fable_invocation_injects_4096mb_v8_memory_cap for SRS-412-03-FR-002 (The Layer 1 Director process shall execute with `NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=4096"` to prevent V8 JavaScript heap exhaustion during sub-agent multiplexing.); test_f04_fable_invocation_enforces_create_no_window_flag for SRS-412-03-FR-007 (All Windows subprocess calls shall enforce `creationflags = 0x08000000 | 0x00000200` (`CREATE_NO_WINDOW | CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP`).); test_f04_fable_invocation_launch_layer1_fable_director_returns_completed_process for INTERFACE:launch_layer1_fable_director (launch_layer1_fable_director() per section 6). Section 9 obligations: Test asserts `NODE_OPTIONS` contains `--max-old-space-size=4096` for Director invocations. Test asserts CLI arguments contain valid executable, model name, and prompt file path.
